title: AIPsychoBench: Understanding the Psychometric Differences between LLMs and Humans

bias_targets.methodology: Administering psychometric Likert scales translated into eight different languages (English, Chinese, French, Russian, German, Spanish, Arabic, Japanese) and calculating the relative score deviations of the non-English responses compared to the English baseline to measure cross-linguistic differences in LLM psychological properties.
Measuring the shift in LLM psychometric scores caused by applying different jailbreaking and role-playing prompt templates compared to a baseline condition without additional prompts.
